class View:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows=[]
        self.notes={}
        self.loading=False
        self.error=None
        self.seq=0
        self.current_request_id=None
        self._accepted_rows=None
    def begin(self, query):
        self.seq += 1
        request_id = self.seq
        self.current_request_id = request_id
        self.loading = True
        self.error = None
        # copy accepted rows if any
        if self._accepted_rows is not None:
            self.rows = list(self._accepted_rows)  # copy
        return request_id
    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        # only the latest begun request can update rows, once
        if request_id != self.current_request_id:
            return False  # stale or duplicate reply
        if self.loading:
            self.loading = False
            # accept these rows once
            self._accepted_rows = list(rows)  # copy
            # rows will be set when finish is called for the latest request
            self.rows = self._accepted_rows
            return True

        # begin clears loading errors but keeps existing rows until valid finish
        # so if finish called without begin? unlikely
        self.current_request_id = None
        self.rows = rows
        return True

import view

def test_basic():
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    assert v.loading == True
    # finish with same id should succeed
    ok = v.finish(id1, ['row1'])
    assert ok == True
    assert v.rows == ['row1']
    assert v.loading == False
    # begin again
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    # finish id1 (stale) should return False
    ok2 = v.finish(id1, ['row1b'])
    assert ok2 == False
    # finish id2 with rows should succeed
    ok3 = v.finish(id2, ['row2'])
    assert ok3 == True
    assert v.rows == ['row2']
    # begin without finish then finish
    id3 = v.begin('q3')
    ok4 = v.finish(id3, ['row3'])
    assert ok4 == True
    assert v.rows == ['row3']

def test_duplicate():
    v = view.View()
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    id2 = v.begin('q2')  # newer request
    # finish id1 (duplicate/stale) should return False
    ok = v.finish(id1, ['wrong'])
    assert ok == False
    # finish id2 should succeed
    ok2 = v.finish(id2, ['row2'])
    assert ok2 == True
    assert v.rows == ['row2']

def test_preserve_notes():
    v = view.View()
    # notes dict should persist
    v.notes['job1'] = 'note1'
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    ok = v.finish(id1, ['row1'])
    assert ok == True
    # notes still there
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'
    # begin again doesn't clear notes
    id2 = v.begin('q2')
    v.notes['job2'] = 'note2'
    ok2 = v.finish(id2, ['row2'])
    assert ok2 == True
    assert v.notes['job1'] == 'note1'
    assert v.notes['job2'] == 'note2'

def test_loading_clears_error():
    v = view.View()
    v.error = 'some error'
    assert v.loading == False
    id1 = v.begin('q1')
    # begin clears loading errors but keeps existing rows until valid finish
    # error should be cleared
    assert v.error is None
    # rows should be kept (copied from accepted rows if any)
    # no rows yet
    ok = v.finish(id1, ['row1'])
    assert ok == True
    assert v.rows == ['row1']
